text:
ana (FinOps): Heads up: Found double billing on MeadowCare INV-2027-210. Platform fee appears charged twice for July during private migration. Need quick fix before month-end close.
raj (Billing): Paste the invoice lines?
ana (FinOps): From invoice PDF:
INV-2027-210
Line 5: Platform Fee - Period 01Jan2027-31Dec2027 - $96,000
Line 12: Migration charge - Private Deployment - Period 01Jul2027-31Dec2027 - $48,000
Line 18: Adjustment - migration prorate credit - Amount: $0

kevin (CS): Customer migrated 2027-07-01 per amendment AMEND-42 (signed 2027-06-28). Sales told CS to expect pro-rate, not extra migration charge.
sven (Sales): Confirmed. Sales ops ticket SO-2201 requested proration and remove duplicate platform line.
raj (Billing): I can see the pipeline created both the annual platform fee and a separate migration line due to a mapping rule for older contracts. Looks like the migration line shouldn't be billed when annual is present for same period. Creating billing-engine ticket.
billing-bot: New issue BE-6021 created: "duplicate platform fee for contracts with migration addendum" assigned to billing-engine-team. https://issues.redwood/BE-6021
ana (FinOps): we need manual credit now. Rough math: migration line $48k overlaps 6 months of the annual $96k; correct treatment = pro-rate annual for Jul-Dec ($48k) and zero migration extra. So credit $48k.
raj (Billing): I'll prepare credit memo for $48k and corrected invoice. Will attach AMEND-42 and SO-2201 and route for sign-off AR-7010. ETA by EOD.
kevin (CS): I'll notify MeadowCare that we're issuing a corrected invoice and credit memo, not a pricing change.
ana (FinOps): please add auditor note referencing AMEND-42 and include calculation: 96000 * 6/12 = 48000.
raj (Billing): noted. BE-6021 will also include backfill to catch any similar invoices from last quarter.
billing-bot: BE-6021 update: triage complete, hotfix scheduled to staging. Backfill planned for next nightly run.
ana (FinOps): thanks all. once credit posts I'll reconcile revenue and remove the duplicate from renewal schedule.
